 "rationale": "A plain two-stage Miller reaches only about 78 dB in sky130, so it cannot meet 90 dB. A folded-cascode first stage (60-70 dB) plus a CS stage (about 34 dB) gives more than 95 dB. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) is about 9 MHz. p2 = gm7/CL is about 28 MHz, and an LHP zero from Rz brings PM above 70 degrees. The rail-to-rail CS output swings about 1.4 V. PARAMS = {
    "gm1":   (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.5),       # input pair L
    "Itail": (20e-6, 10e-6, 30e-6),  # tail current
    "Ifold": (10e-6, 5e-6, 20e-6),   # current in each cascode branch
    "I7":    (100e-6, 50e-6, 120e-6),# second-stage current
    "Cc":    (2.5e-12, 1e-12, 5e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.5, 0.5, 4.0),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # L of cascodes / mirrors / sources
    "gn":    (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "gp":    (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS current-source gm/Id
}

def _size_for_vgs(lut, dev, L, Id, vgs_t, vds, vsb=0.0):
    # Bisection on gm/Id so that a diode device has |vgs| = vgs_t (vgs decreases with gm/Id)
    lo, hi = 2.0, 20.0
    op = None
    for _ in range(30):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        op = lut.size(dev, mid, L, Id, vds=vds, vsb=vsb)
        if op.vgs > vgs_t:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return op

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    Lc, gn, gp = p["Lc"], p["gn"], p["gp"]
    Itail, Ifold, I7 = p["Itail"], p["Ifold"], p["I7"]
    Ih = Itail / 2
    Itop = Ih + Ifold
    Ibr = iref  # each bias branch

    # ---- NMOS mirror family from ibias ----
    mnb = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, iref, vds=0.65)          # ibias diode
    mt = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, Itail, vds=0.25)          # tail
    m8 = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, I7, vds=0.9)              # output-stage sink
    mnbr = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, Ibr, vds=0.6)           # bias branch sinks

    # ---- input pair ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gm1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=1.2, vsb=0.25)

    # ---- PMOS top current sources ----
    vsd_top = None
    mp = lut.size("p", gp, Lc, Itop, vds=0.3)
    vsd_top = mp.vdsat + 0.12
    mp = lut.size("p", gp, Lc, Itop, vds=vsd_top)
    mpd = lut.size("p", gp, Lc, Ibr, vds=1.0)            # vbp diode
    mps = lut.size("p", gp, Lc, Ibr, vds=0.8)            # source for vncas branch

    # ---- PMOS cascodes ----
    mcp = lut.size("p", 12.0, Lc, Ifold, vds=0.5, vsb=vsd_top)
    vpcas_sg = vsd_top + mcp.vgs                          # VDD - vpcas
    mpc = _size_for_vgs(lut, "p", 2.0, Ibr, vpcas_sg, vds=vpcas_sg)

    # ---- NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror ----
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, Ifold, vds=0.25)
    vds_b = mb.vdsat + 0.1
    mb = lut.size("n", gn, Lc, Ifold, vds=vds_b)
    mcn = lut.size("n", 12.0, Lc, Ifold, vds=0.4, vsb=vds_b)
    vncas = vds_b + mcn.vgs
    mncd = _size_for_vgs(lut, "n", 2.0, Ibr, vncas, vds=vncas)

    # ---- second stage ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 0.5, I7, vds=0.9)
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MNB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNBP", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnbr)
    n.dev("MPD", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MNBC", "vpcas", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnbr)
    n.dev("MPC", "vpcas", "vpcas", "vdd", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("MPS", "vncas", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("MNCD", "vncas", "vncas", "vss", "vss", mncd)
    # input pair (vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # folded cascode
    n.dev("MP1", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MCP1", "ya", "vpcas", "fa", "vdd", mcp)
    n.dev("MCP2", "x", "vpcas", "fb", "vdd", mcp)
    n.dev("MCN1", "ya", "vncas", "sa", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("MCN2", "x", "vncas", "sb", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("MB1", "sa", "ya", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MB2", "sb", "ya", "vss", "vss", mb)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "xc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "xc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro_top = 1.0 / (mp.gds + m1.gds)
    Rp = (mcp.gm + mcp.gmbs) / mcp.gds * ro_top
    Rn = (mcn.gm + mcn.gmbs) / mcn.gds / mb.gds
    Rx = Rp * Rn / (Rp + Rn)
    A1 = gm1 * Rx
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    Cx = m7.cgg + mcp.cdd + mcn.cdd
    Co = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    wp2 = m7.gm * Cc / (Cx * Cc + Cx * Co + Cc * Co)
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)) if Rz > 1.0 / m7.gm else -1.0 / (Cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz))
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    wfold = mcp.gm / (mp.cdd + m1.cdd + mcp.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wfold))
    pm += math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wz)) if wz > 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(wu / abs(wz)))
    itot = iref + Itail + 2 * Itop + I7 + 3 * Ibr
    power = VDD * itot
    swing = VDD - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
